verified_gap: Current V15 presence schema/runtime/test model lease_epoch/holder/presence/recovery, but expose no current_task_id, task_epoch, task-state or user-consent transition witness. This proves only that the presence substrate itself cannot enforce same-lease task continuity; it does NOT prove that no other future/upstream component could supply the missing fence.

concurrent_mesh.same_holder_execution_gap: GO receipt records no execution_id/current_request_id and a queued independent discriminator

non_collision: LICF does not solve holder exclusivity, same-holder parallel execution admission, ASVB voice authority, MCM causal cuts, SCF semantic charges, ECT CallContracts, or MOLT physical persistence. It tests the nested problem of stale task-derived material after an otherwise valid execution holder changes tasks.
